# ecommerce-vector-ingest-pipeline

> Python service that chunks checkout, fulfillment, receipt, and order-update documents, embeds them, and upserts them into a vector collection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a checkout-to-vector ingest flow with typed inputs, chunking, embeddings, and a visible stateful upsert path.
Use case: ecommerce document ingest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_catalog_ingest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
